stocks.name: Congressional hearings on electrotech security
stocks.measures: Count of public House/Senate committee hearings touching electrotech supply-chain security in the trailing quarter
stocks.increases_when: Crisis inject or leak surfaces compromise; Wave-2 allocation losers lobby; PRC retaliation makes headlines
stocks.decreases_when: Quarter rolls over with no salient incident; attention shifts to other crises; recess
stocks.rationale: Fast public barometer of legislative attention; spikes on the Wave-3 inject and is the most visible early signal the secret clock is going public.

stocks.name: Electrotech security laws/authorities enacted
stocks.measures: Cumulative laws or binding authorities actually enacted (appropriations, mandates, certification regimes) as opposed to merely introduced
stocks.increases_when: Bipartisan alignment converges; a major inject forces emergency passage; appropriations cycle lands
stocks.decreases_when: Sunset of temporary authorities; effectively monotonic and slow
stocks.rationale: The hard, slow output of the political system; rewards players who built coalition before the inject. Bills-introduced folded in as the leading flow into this stock.

stocks.name: Executive orders on electrotech supply chain
stocks.measures: Cumulative active EOs / presidential directives governing electrotech sourcing, certification, or ICTS transactions
stocks.increases_when: White House acts unilaterally when Congress stalls; inject forces emergency directive; task force recommends action
stocks.decreases_when: Revocation on administration shift; legal challenge or injunction enjoins an EO
stocks.rationale: Fast executive lever that moves in a single round under gridlock, but spends political capital, invites litigation, and risks burning the source if too overt. Absorbs the litigation-constraint draft as a durability haircut on this lever.

stocks.name: Federal agencies with active electrotech rulemakings
stocks.measures: Count of agencies (Commerce/BIS, DHS/CISA, Energy, DOT, FCC) with open rulemakings on electrotech sourcing or security baselines
stocks.increases_when: EO directs new rulemaking; task force assigns a sector to a lead agency; inject triggers emergency interim rules
stocks.decreases_when: Rule finalized (moves to enforcement) or withdrawn under industry pressure; litigation stay
stocks.rationale: The administrative-state workhorse and quietest lever for acting without burning the HUMINT source.

stocks.name: Interagency alignment & decision velocity
stocks.measures: Coherence and decision velocity across White House/Commerce/DHS/Energy/DoD/Justice/State/IC on prioritization and messaging
stocks.increases_when: Task force reaches consensus prioritization; clear lead-agency assignments; shared classified picture; principals back the task force
stocks.decreases_when: Jurisdiction/budget fights (DoD classified channel vs civilian allocation); State fears allied blowback; Justice/State raise legal/diplomatic vetoes; inject creates blame dynamics
stocks.rationale: Core enabler — high alignment unlocks EOs, DPA, rulemakings; low cohesion silently slows every player decision.

stocks.name: Executive political capital for electrotech action
stocks.measures: Discretionary political capital available to spend on contested electrotech moves before approval cost bites
stocks.increases_when: Successful crisis management; rally effect after inject handled well; allied wins announced; early bipartisan buy-in
stocks.decreases_when: Each EO/DPA/unpopular allocation spends it; constituency backlash; visible price spikes or shortages blamed on policy
stocks.rationale: The scarce currency of executive action — spent fast and slow to refill, forcing players to sequence bold moves.

stocks.name: Congressional bipartisan consensus
stocks.measures: Degree of cross-party agreement that electrotech compromise warrants funded action vs partisan blame framing
stocks.increases_when: Shared China-threat framing; classified briefings to both caucuses; inject creates rally effect
stocks.decreases_when: Allocation losers' districts split on party lines; administration blamed for delay; election-year polarization; source leak politicized
stocks.rationale: Gates whether bills become enacted law; low value means hearings produce theater not authority. Merges majority/minority support and oversight-posture drafts into one governing consensus dial.

stocks.name: DPA invocations for electrotech
stocks.measures: Cumulative active Defense Production Act Title I/III actions directed at electrotech across all four sectors
stocks.increases_when: Task force prioritizes a sector for emergency domestic buildout; inject forces wartime-footing production; Congress appropriates Title III funds
stocks.decreases_when: Authority lapses; appropriations exhausted; industry/fiscal pushback caps further use
stocks.rationale: High-blast-radius lever bridging Political/Economic that visibly commits government to a sector but spends capital and signals alarm.

stocks.name: Industry association & coalition opposition
stocks.measures: Intensity of major coalitions (SIA, NEMA, hyperscaler groups, auto/utility associations) publicly opposing the allocation or controls
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Subsidies/safe-supply access buy buy-in; shared threat framing co-opts industry; classified briefings align CEOs
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Allocation creates clear sector losers (Wave 2); compliance/destructive-testing costs hit margins; rules imposed without consultation
stocks.rationale: Inverted lobbying-backlash gauge — the chief political cost of a contested allocation and the main Wave-2 channel through which losers fight back. Merges the public 'associations critical' and the deeper industry-cooperation reservoir.

stocks.name: Managed-unwind policy credibility/durability
stocks.measures: Domestic credibility and time-consistency of the multi-year managed-unwind commitment across administrations, election and budget cycles
stocks.increases_when: Consistent multi-round prioritization; bipartisan enacted authorities; funding actually obligated; coherent messaging
stocks.decreases_when: Whipsawed rankings; partisan reversal threats; underfunded commitments; chaotic inject response
stocks.rationale: The closing-wave win-framing stock — whether the decade-long unwind is believed durable; feeds private capital and allied confidence. Central to wrap-up scoring.

stocks.name: PRC escalation & retaliation posture
stocks.measures: PRC's propensity to retaliate via supply withholding, accelerated compromise activation, cyber pressure, or coercion of allies in response to US moves
stocks.unit: 0-100 escalation index (raw high=bad); inverted, normalized 0-1 (0=max escalation, 1=fully restrained)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) US maintains ambiguity, avoids provocation, keeps intel covert, gives PRC no trigger to activate compromise early
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) US actions risk burning the source or signaling detection; public attribution; allies visibly decouple; US sanctions Chinese electrotech firms
stocks.rationale: Engine-only PRC willingness stock central to Wave 3; provocation pulls the timeline-collapse forward. Merges the visible escalation ladder and private posture into one private dial to avoid double-counting.

stocks.name: PRC compromise activation readiness
stocks.measures: Operational readiness of pre-positioned compromise to be activated on a go-code — share of installed base wired for coordinated remote effect now
stocks.unit: 0-100 readiness index (raw high=bad); inverted, normalized 0-1 (0=fully primed, 1=disrupted)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) US/allied counter-ops disrupt command paths; segmentation/air-gapping limits reach; firmware trust-roots hardened
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Deployed-compromise base grows; signing/update chains stay exposed; insertion cell matures coordinated-effect capability
stocks.rationale: Capability-to-act-now, distinct from willingness (posture) and option value (leverage); the Wave-3 sabotage inject draws on this readiness. Absorbs firmware trust-root integrity as its key driver.

stocks.name: DoD platform adversary-origin electrotech dependency
stocks.measures: Share of fielded major weapons/C5ISR platforms containing batteries, power electronics, packaged semis, or optics of Chinese/unknown provenance
stocks.unit: % of platforms (display); inverted, normalized 0-1 (1=no adversary dependency)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Classified-channel certified supply substitutes parts; DPA-funded lines qualify; destructive testing clears lots; legacy 'dumb' parts prioritized over compromised control-layer parts
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Compromise rate rises and new procurement pulls in tainted COTS; emergency gray-market buys; audits reveal sub-tier dependencies
stocks.rationale: Core readiness-exposure stock; worsens as the compromise clock ticks; stored inverted so higher=less dependent.

stocks.name: Classified-channel certified supply assurance for DoD
stocks.measures: Degree to which DoD priority defense needs are met through dedicated trusted/certified channels outside the civilian allocation pool
stocks.unit: % of priority defense demand assured (display); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: DoD secures dedicated allied trusted-foundry/cell capacity; classified set-asides expand; accredited base grows
stocks.decreases_when: Inject collapses timeline and civilian demand cannibalizes the same allied pool; compromise spreads into trusted lines; allied capacity recommitted elsewhere
stocks.rationale: Models the premise that DoD 'gets what it needs' but still draws on the same scarce certified pool; private so players infer the squeeze via injects. The hidden second claimant on the zero-sum allied supply.

stocks.name: Critical mineral / strategic material stockpile coverage
stocks.measures: Days of National Defense Stockpile coverage for electrotech-critical inputs (gallium, germanium, rare earths, graphite, lithium precursors) at surge demand
stocks.increases_when: DLA stockpile purchases; allied material-sharing agreements; domestic refining/recycling comes online (slow)
stocks.decreases_when: PRC export controls on gallium/germanium/graphite; surge consumption during reshoring ramp; drawdown to plug civilian gaps
stocks.rationale: Upstream chokepoint beneath all four sectors and the defense base; PRC can squeeze it, and it moves sharply on retaliation injects.

stocks.name: Trusted foundry / accredited supplier base
stocks.measures: Size of the DoD-accredited trusted supplier and foundry base authorized to deliver certified-safe electrotech across the four sectors
stocks.increases_when: New domestic/allied lines pass accreditation; Trusted Access programs expand; private suppliers seek certification
stocks.decreases_when: Suppliers fail re-accreditation, exit defense work, or get compromised; standards tighten faster than the base grows
stocks.rationale: Underlies classified-channel assurance and defense packaging; slow buildout defining the ceiling on trusted supply DoD can allocate.

stocks.name: Certified-safe allied supply pool (master, uncommitted)
stocks.measures: Total certified-safe allied (Japan/Korea/Germany) component supply NOT yet committed elsewhere and actually available for US civilian allocation across all four sectors — the master scarce pool the four teams compete over
stocks.unit: % of aggregate US civilian demand coverable (~12-22%); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Allied trust/cohesion rises freeing diversion; allies expand certified lines; reconfiguration matures; joint procurement statements; prior commitments expire; DoD classified channels relieve civilian demand
stocks.decreases_when: Any team's #1/#2 ranking claims a tranche; allies recommit elsewhere; PRC pressures allies; hyperscaler/crisis demand surge depletes it
stocks.rationale: The central zero-sum scarcity engine: one team's #1 priority necessarily depletes what remains for the other three. Per-sector sub-pools are derived partitions of this single conserved stock, not independent dials.

stocks.name: Japan (METI) allocated safe supply share
stocks.measures: Certified-safe supply pledged by Japan/METI and earmarked for US, concentrated in batteries, power electronics, and packaging substrate where Japan leads
stocks.increases_when: US-Japan procurement statements and defense-industrial cooperation deepen; Japan trusts US won't burn the source; trade incentives offered
stocks.decreases_when: Teams draw against the Japan tranche; Japan-China coercion (rare earths) forces Japan to hedge; allied trust in US framing falls
stocks.rationale: Per-ally heterogeneity makes diplomacy a lever and shows the pool is not fungible; maps to specific sector strengths.

stocks.name: Korea + Germany allocated safe supply share
stocks.measures: Certified-safe supply pledged by South Korea (battery cells, packaging) and Germany (power electronics, grid hardware) earmarked for US civilian use
stocks.unit: 0-40 normalized units (% of packaging+power-electronics demand coverable); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Korea/Germany alliance assessments align with US framing; EU/Korea co-investment; credible long-horizon demand commitments
stocks.decreases_when: Teams draw the tranche; Korea/Germany prioritize own decarbonization/grid demand; PRC pressure or export-control friction
stocks.rationale: Splitting the pool by ally with distinct sector strengths sharpens which team can realistically be served by whom; Germany's deep China ties make this tranche the most volatile.

stocks.name: Allied coalition cohesion, bandwidth & demand-signal credibility
stocks.measures: Aggregate willingness AND domestic political room of Japan/Korea/Germany to share scarce certified supply and align threat framing, net of PRC ally-splitting inducements, weighted by their confidence US prioritization will persist long enough to justify reconfiguring lines
stocks.increases_when: Cost-sharing and joint procurement; US co-investment de-risks allied firms; aligned threat assessments; US restraint avoids spooking allies; consistent multi-round prioritization; source not burned
stocks.decreases_when: US unilateralism or whipsawed rankings; allied auto/industrial lobbies resist diversion (Germany especially); PRC counter-inducement (market access, price concessions) splits the coalition; clumsy disclosure; zero-sum scramble
stocks.rationale: The trust multiplier that modulates the size and growth rate of the zero-sum allied pool. Merges per-ally trust, aggregate cohesion, demand-signal credibility, allied domestic political bandwidth, AND the PRC ally-splitting counter-inducement draft into one managed relationship dial (PRC inducement enters as a decreases_when driver, not a separate stock).

stocks.name: Domestic battery cell manufacturing capacity (online + pipeline)
stocks.measures: Operational plus committed-under-construction US battery cell capacity able to displace Chinese cells across consumer, EV, drone, utility, and data-center categories
stocks.increases_when: Federal funding obligated; private capital commits; DPA; #1 allocation brings gigafactories online (18-24mo to start, 3-5yr to scale)
stocks.decreases_when: Capital flight, project cancellations, workforce/refining chokepoints starve throughput
stocks.rationale: Core slow-buildout stock for the ~80% China-dependent battery sector; barely moves in 3-4 rounds by design, teaching reshoring is a decade lever. Pipeline folded into one capacity stock.

stocks.name: Domestic/allied advanced packaging capacity (% of demand)
stocks.measures: Share of US packaged-semiconductor demand advanced-packageable on US or reconfigured allied lines rather than in China (online + in-reconfiguration)
stocks.increases_when: Allied line reconfiguration (12-18mo); CHIPS-style funding; OSAT investment; priority allocation
stocks.decreases_when: Demand surges outpace buildout; funding lapses; COVID-style small gaps cascade
stocks.rationale: Packaging is the 30-40% China chokepoint but faster to reconfigure than batteries, so it can show meaningful late-game movement. Pipeline folded in.

stocks.name: Domestic power electronics & grid hardware capacity (% of demand)
stocks.measures: Share of US power-electronics/grid-hardware demand (inverters, transformers, switchgear, charging, port electrification) met by domestic production (online + pipeline)
stocks.increases_when: Investment in transformer/inverter plants; NEMA-coordinated expansion; DPA; utility offtake; priority safe-supply
stocks.decreases_when: Surging electrification/data-center demand outruns supply; long transformer lead times; steel/copper/GOES constraints
stocks.rationale: Models the 50-60% dependent sector where demand surges faster than buildout. Pipeline folded in.

stocks.name: Domestic/allied network optics capacity (% of demand)
stocks.measures: Share of US network-optics demand (transceivers, modules, ROADMs, DWDM) met by domestic/trusted production (online + pipeline)
stocks.increases_when: Domestic optical-module assembly investment; hyperscaler trusted contracts; allied photonics tech-transfer; priority allocation
stocks.decreases_when: Cloud/AI bandwidth demand outpaces buildout; optics treated as commodity so capital under-flows; photonics workforce shortfalls
stocks.rationale: Optics is the 40-50% dependent, highest-value surveillance vector; capacity protects the persistent-collection blast radius. Pipeline folded in.

stocks.name: Federal fiscal & industrial-policy headroom
stocks.measures: Remaining budgetary/political-economic capacity to fund new electrotech interventions without crowding out or breaching debt constraints
stocks.increases_when: Growth, offsets, reprioritization, new appropriations; private capital crowds in; allied cost-sharing
stocks.decreases_when: Each funding obligation, DPA invocation, crisis-response spending consumes headroom; multiple teams demand funding simultaneously
stocks.rationale: Constrains how much can be spent across all four sectors; spent quickly under crisis, slow to return. Subsumes federal-funding-obligated as the draw against this reservoir.

stocks.name: Private capital committed to domestic electrotech
stocks.measures: Cumulative private investment committed to US/allied electrotech manufacturing across the four sectors
stocks.increases_when: Policy certainty, federal cost-share/loan guarantees, demand signals, clear prioritization, durable managed-unwind credibility de-risk investment
stocks.decreases_when: Policy ambiguity, source-burning panic, or crisis-driven uncertainty triggers capital flight and project pauses
stocks.rationale: The multiplier on federal dollars; responsive within the game horizon to confidence shocks like the Wave-3 inject.

stocks.name: Grid transformer / HV switchgear delivery timeliness
stocks.measures: Average procurement/delivery lead time for large power transformers and long-lead HV grid hardware
stocks.unit: months lead time 0-120 (display); inverted, normalized 0-1 (1=short lead time)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Capacity expansion, allied sourcing, demand smoothing, strategic spares shorten lead times
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Demand surge, China supply withdrawal, GOES shortage, or quality-testing requirements lengthen them
stocks.rationale: A known acute bottleneck; slow to improve, worsens instantly under coercion. Stored inverted so higher=shorter lead time.

stocks.name: Electrotech market & macroeconomic confidence
stocks.measures: Aggregate investor/market confidence in US electrotech-dependent sectors plus near-term macro stability around the supply-chain risk (input-cost inflation, shortage absence)
stocks.increases_when: Orderly managed unwind, credible policy, contained information, sourcing diversification reassure markets
stocks.decreases_when: Source-burning leaks, panic, inject revealing installed compromise, PRC coercion shortages, or visible scarcity shock confidence
stocks.rationale: Fast-moving sentiment translating the secrecy/panic tradeoff into economic terms; a key Wave-3 collapse channel. Absorbs the separate aggregate-economic-stability and supply-chain-resilience indices to avoid three correlated macro dials.

stocks.name: Skilled electrotech manufacturing workforce
stocks.measures: Qualified workers (technicians, process/packaging/photonics engineers, line operators) trained for domestic battery, packaging, power-electronics, and optics manufacturing
stocks.increases_when: Apprenticeship/training programs graduate cohorts; CHIPS/IRA workforce funds; firms in-house train as plants open; reshoring wages draw talent
stocks.decreases_when: Retirements/attrition; talent poached to higher-margin tech; facility cancellations strand workers; immigration limits cut skilled inflow
stocks.rationale: The binding human constraint on every reshoring decision; slow buildout. Absorbs the per-sector workforce and pipeline drafts into one master pool to avoid near-static dashboard noise.

stocks.name: Cross-sector talent rivalry
stocks.measures: Intensity of zero-sum competition for the same scarce skilled workers across the four sectors' simultaneous buildouts
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Prioritization focused on fewer sectors; distributed training expands the pool; automation reduces headcount need
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) All four sectors prioritized at once; simultaneous plant ramps bid up the same talent; poaching across hubs
stocks.rationale: Reinforces the zero-sum lesson on the labor axis — spreading priorities thin makes labor more rivalrous, a hidden coupling distinct from raw workforce level.

stocks.name: Public awareness/concern of electrotech threat
stocks.measures: Share of public ranking foreign-compromised technology/supply-chain security as a top national concern
stocks.increases_when: IC/CISA advisories surface; news of compromise; inject goes public; high-profile incident attributed to electrotech
stocks.decreases_when: Issue fatigue; competing crises; reassurance messaging; no visible incidents; deliberate suppression to protect the source
stocks.rationale: Double-edged: low baseline protects the source, but the inject can spike it into panic — the core information-management dilemma. Merges the Social and Information public-awareness duplicates into one dial.

stocks.name: Consumer affordability (reshoring price pain)
stocks.measures: Household-felt cost increases for electronics, EVs, appliances, broadband, and energy driven by de-risking from Chinese supply, including the certified/destructively-tested component premium
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Allied/domestic supply scales lowering premiums; subsidies offset costs; phased unwind avoids shocks
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Abrupt de-risking raises prices; PRC withholds supply; testing overhead passed to consumers; scarcity bidding for the allied pool; inject forces rushed substitution
stocks.rationale: Pocketbook stock translating strategic choices into kitchen-table politics; drives Wave-2 constituency pushback. Absorbs the separate trusted-component price-index (a producer-side view of the same premium). Stored inverted so higher=less pain.

stocks.name: Affected-region constituency sentiment
stocks.measures: Net favorability among workers, communities, and regions whose jobs/plants hinge on prioritization outcomes (battery belt, fab regions, port cities, rural broadband)
stocks.increases_when: A region's sector receives priority safe supply and investment; local job announcements; visible federal support
stocks.decreases_when: A constituency's sector deprioritized (#5); plant closures or price pain; perceived unfair allocation across regions
stocks.rationale: Zero-sum prioritization creates regional winners and losers; the engine for Wave-2 pushback. Merges the constituency-backlash and region-sentiment drafts into one symmetric dial.

stocks.name: Public trust & calm in government handling
stocks.measures: Public confidence that the federal interagency is competently, honestly, and fairly managing the compromise threat without panic, hoarding, or favoritism
stocks.increases_when: Coherent transparent policy; visible fair wins; coordinated allied messaging; orderly managed unwind; constituencies feel heard
stocks.decreases_when: Perceived secrecy/cover-up if source burns; chaotic inject response; partisan blame; disinformation; favoritism
stocks.rationale: Central governance-legitimacy stock constraining how aggressively players can act and whether the public accepts the decade-long unwind.

stocks.name: Localized service-disruption incidence (electrotech-attributed)
stocks.measures: Frequency/severity of household-felt service failures attributed to electrotech (blackouts, broadband outages, EV/appliance recalls)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Safe supply protects control-layer; redundancy/legacy retention; intrusions evicted
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Wave-3 sabotage activation; compromised control-layer failures; thin reserves under demand surge
stocks.rationale: The concrete kitchen-table channel that converts a Wave-3 sabotage inject into constituency backlash, distinct from price pain and abstract trust.

stocks.name: HUMINT source protection & OPSEC margin
stocks.measures: Integrity of the exquisite HUMINT source and program secrecy — protective latitude remaining before US policy moves expose it
stocks.unit: 0-100 OPSEC integrity (1.0 = fully protected, 0 = burned); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Actions stay covert and deniable; parallel construction established; tight compartmentation; allies kept quietly in the loop; patient sequencing
stocks.decreases_when: Abrupt targeted sourcing shifts; destructive-testing patterns reveal foreknowledge; overt EOs/hearings/leaks; over-broad read-in; public attribution
stocks.rationale: Central spendable trust asset that, once spent, does not return; every overt win quietly burns it. Merges the three source-protection drafts.

stocks.name: Secret-disclosure / time-to-public clock
stocks.measures: Remaining buffer before the HUMINT intel becomes public via leak, journalism, indictment, allied disclosure, PRC counter-disclosure, or incident
stocks.unit: 0-24 months remaining secrecy (1.0 = ample runway); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Tight OPSEC; narrow read-in; cover stories hold; controlled pre-briefing of select press/allies; no forcing incident
stocks.decreases_when: Each round elapses (scheduled drain); public actions tied to the intel; widening briefing circle; aggressive enforcement; journalist inquiries; PRC counter-leak; inject collapses the clock
stocks.rationale: The secret clock racing toward public; drives Wave-3 inject timing; players infer remaining runway only via hints.

stocks.name: Wave-3 discovery shock magnitude (assumption-vs-truth gap)
stocks.measures: Magnitude of the already-installed surprise: the gap between what players assume is deployed and the engine's true deployed-compromise base
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Players' perception tracks ground truth via destructive testing/OSINT; sector threat clarity rises; remediation pre-positioned
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Perception lags as the deployed base accumulates unseen; complacency widens the gap; inject reveals far more installed than assumed
stocks.rationale: Quantifies the Wave-3 timeline-collapse bite: a large assumption-vs-truth gap drives bigger shocks to confidence, panic, and escalation. The central inject lever, private and engine-only. Retagged 'other' (a derived gap, not itself a ticking clock).

stocks.name: US narrative dominance vs PRC
stocks.measures: Net share of the framing contest (legitimate security concern vs protectionist scaremongering) across domestic and allied audiences
stocks.unit: -100..+100 raw, affine-mapped to 0-1 (0=PRC frame wins, 0.5=contested, 1=US frame wins)
stocks.increases_when: Credible declassified/parallel-construction evidence; aligned allied assessments; coherent interagency messaging; attributed PRC incidents surface
stocks.decreases_when: PRC info-ops land; US messaging looks protectionist/incoherent; industry disputes the threat; allies break with US framing; premature disclosure triggers panic narrative
stocks.rationale: Whoever owns the narrative shapes political room to maneuver; moves each wave. Also carries interagency messaging coherence as an input.

stocks.name: PRC disinformation campaign intensity
stocks.measures: Volume and reach of active PRC-directed influence operations targeting US electrotech policy (protectionism framing, ally-splitting, source-doubt seeding)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Platform takedowns; attribution/pre-bunking; US narrative dominance crowds it out; diplomatic deterrence raises PRC cost
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) PRC senses exposure and retaliates; US actions go public; prioritization losers amplified; the inject hits
stocks.rationale: Adversary influence stock that stays low while the program is secret and spikes after the Wave-3 inject; baseline raised so disclosure has room to move it.

stocks.name: Public attribution & source-laundering capability
stocks.measures: Strength of publicly releasable, legally actionable attribution linking compromise to PRC direction independent of the protected source (covers what can be SAID and used in enforcement)
stocks.increases_when: OSINT corroboration accumulates; parallel-construction intel matured for indictments/sanctions/seizures; allied intel adds weight; forensic firmware evidence captured
stocks.decreases_when: Only source-derived intel available (unreleasable); PRC denial/false-flag muddies attribution
stocks.rationale: Distinguishes what the US KNOWS from what it can SAY and USE in court; gates indictments, ICTS enforcement, and public action without burning the source. Merges public-attribution, OSINT-corroboration, and source-admissibility drafts.

stocks.name: Threat advisory & industry info-sharing coverage
stocks.measures: Breadth of official advisories plus depth of trusted bidirectional threat-sharing with SIA, NEMA, hyperscalers, and utilities (without naming the source)
stocks.unit: 0-100% of sectors with actionable guidance + sharing throughput (display); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Cleared briefings to industry; ISAC/CISA partnerships deepen; sector-specific advisories with IOCs; declassification authorized
stocks.decreases_when: Guidance withheld to protect the source; industry distrust after prioritization losses; advisories age; sharing fatigue
stocks.rationale: Converts intel into industry action but raising it risks the source — a real per-round tradeoff. Merges IC/CISA advisory coverage and gov-industry info-sharing.

stocks.name: Non-destructive safe-vs-compromised discrimination
stocks.measures: Non-destructive confidence with which the US can distinguish safe from compromised components at scale (detection + scalable signatures)
stocks.increases_when: Detection R&D, forensic tooling, allied sharing, and testing data accumulate into scalable signatures; AI/scan tooling matures (slow)
stocks.decreases_when: PRC varies insertion to defeat signatures; compromise diversity outpaces signatures; scale overwhelms screening
stocks.rationale: Starts near-zero by premise (cannot distinguish without destructive testing); its slow rise is the long-game off-ramp from blind prioritization. Merges generic detection capability into this premise-defining dial.

stocks.name: Remediation guidance & panic buffer
stocks.measures: Reach of actionable government triage/mitigation playbooks and pre-positioned messaging that dampen fear-driven information cascade once compromise becomes known
stocks.unit: 0-100% sectors with deployable playbooks + messaging readiness (display); normalized 0-1, higher=more buffered
stocks.increases_when: CISA/sector playbooks published; destructive-test signatures shared; smart/dumb triage frameworks distributed; phased disclosure messaging pre-staged
stocks.decreases_when: Guidance withheld to protect source; abrupt disclosure without prep; threat evolves past guidance; no detection method without destructive testing
stocks.rationale: The antidote to panic contagion — the reassurance/remediation narrative built slowly now to pay off at disclosure. Merges remediation-guidance and panic-contagion into one stored-positive buffer.

stocks.name: Aggregate compromise penetration rate (master clock)
stocks.measures: Share of newly-deployed Chinese-made targeted components across all four sectors carrying embedded surveillance/sabotage capability, ramping on the PRC's clock
stocks.unit: % of new components compromised (display); inverted, normalized 0-1 (1=clean new supply, 0=fully compromised)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Only via slowing new China-sourced deployment as safe-supply share rises
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Scheduled ramp each round (Yr1 5-10% -> Yr2 15% -> Yr3 30-35% -> majority by Yr5); continued dependence; demand surge pulls in more new Chinese components
stocks.rationale: The master scheduled-threat clock that escalates regardless of players and integrates into the deployed-fraction stocks; private so teams infer it via injects. Tagged Infrastructure (world-state, not knowledge). Per-sector rate clocks collapsed into this master with sector waypoints.

stocks.name: Compromised fraction of deployed battery base
stocks.measures: Cumulative share of the installed US battery base (consumer, EV, drone, utility, data-center) already compromised and operational
stocks.unit: % of installed base (display); inverted, normalized 0-1 (1=clean installed base)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Compromised units identified and replaced (slow); destructive testing flags lots; retirement of old stock
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Compromised new components install each round (integral of master rate x new deployments); inject reveals larger pre-installed base
stocks.rationale: Wave-3 reveal stock for batteries — the physical-sabotage exemplar; accumulates as a slow integral, jumped by the inject. Private crisis payload diverging from public sourcing proxies.

stocks.name: Compromised fraction of deployed network optics
stocks.measures: Cumulative share of installed US optical network base already compromised and actively collecting
stocks.unit: % of installed base (display); inverted, normalized 0-1 (1=clean installed base)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Compromised modules identified and replaced; testing flags lots; segmentation isolates suspect links
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) Compromised new optics install each round; inject reveals broad pre-installed collection footprint across broadband/cloud/financial links
stocks.rationale: Wave-3 reveal stock for optics — the persistent-surveillance exemplar; the inject exposes how much is already listening. Batteries and optics retained as the two divergent exemplars per red-team (physical-sabotage vs surveillance); other sectors carried by the aggregate.

stocks.name: Deployed compromised components — aggregate (engine ground-truth)
stocks.measures: Engine's true share of compromised components actually installed across all four sectors — the latent blast radius players never see directly
stocks.unit: % of fielded targeted components compromised (display); inverted, normalized 0-1 (1=clean fielded base)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Destructive testing + replacement with certified parts; prioritizing smart/control-layer over dumb commodity; retiring legacy at-risk gear (slow)
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) New Chinese components install at the scheduled rate; high-connectivity control-layer parts deploy unscreened; inject reveals the pre-installed base
stocks.rationale: Private ground-truth the intel_discovery_shock measures perception against; the Wave-3 crisis collapses this toward the true installed base. Power-electronics and semis deployed-fractions folded here to avoid five lockstep dials.

stocks.name: Control-layer (smart) component exposure
stocks.measures: Share of digitally-active, networked control-layer components (smart inverters, BMS, optical line systems, packaged logic) that are adversary-sourced/suspect across infrastructure
stocks.unit: % of control-layer components suspect (display); inverted, normalized 0-1 (1=control layer secure)
stocks.increases_when: (desirable, raises stored value) Safe supply prioritized to high-connectivity control parts; smart-over-dumb triage in procurement; firmware trust-roots hardened
stocks.decreases_when: (undesirable, lowers stored value) New smart inverters/optics/BMS/packaged-logic install from Chinese supply at the scheduled rate; grid/network digitization accelerates
stocks.rationale: Operationalizes the smart/dumb lens — protecting high-blast-radius control parts; the key efficiency objective players are scored against. A noisy public proxy can be derived from this semi-private truth.

stocks.name: Rip-and-replace remediation throughput & safe-spares buffer
stocks.measures: Physical rate at which identified-compromised installed components can be swapped for certified-safe parts across all four sectors, plus the pre-positioned certified-safe spares buffer that feeds it
stocks.unit: % of identified-compromised installed base replaceable per round + days of safe spares (display); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Certified-safe stockpile pre-positioned before the inject; trusted supply prioritized to highest-blast-radius parts; remediation crews/funding scaled
stocks.decreases_when: Inject surges demand past capacity; long-lead parts (transformers) cannot be swapped in time; allied supply diverted; testing consumes scarce inventory
stocks.rationale: The binding constraint that makes the Wave-3 inject survivable or catastrophic — the realistic outflow for the deployed-compromise stocks. Merges the standalone certified-spares stockpile into this throughput stock since the buffer is only meaningful as remediation feedstock. You can know a part is bad and still be unable to swap it for years.

stocks.name: Grid reliability & reserve margin (electrotech-driven)
stocks.measures: Operating reliability headroom of the bulk and distribution grid against failures triggered by compromised/sabotaged electrotech (composite of reserve margin and resilience)
stocks.increases_when: Safe inverters/transformers deployed; intrusions evicted; redundancy, islanding, and strategic spares added; legacy retention
stocks.decreases_when: Thermal-runaway/remote-kill events; intrusion campaigns; compromised control-layer share rises; thin reserves under demand surge
stocks.rationale: Top-line grid service level the public and Congress react to; a sabotage inject drops it sharply in Wave 3. The power-electronics sector's headline service stock. Merges the Infrastructure margin and Physical reserve-buffer drafts.

stocks.name: Telecom / broadband network integrity & containment
stocks.measures: Assessed integrity (confidentiality + availability) of US fixed/mobile/broadband networks given embedded-optics surveillance and kill-switch risk, including segmentation/encryption that contains blast radius and the share of traffic exposed to collection
stocks.increases_when: Safe optics deployed; rural/broadband builds use certified parts; optical-layer encryption and segmentation/air-gapping shrink the collectable surface; carriers/hyperscalers invest in monitoring
stocks.decreases_when: Compromised optics share rises; PRC activates surveillance/disruption; financial/cloud links exposed; network growth outpaces monitoring
stocks.rationale: Citizen/economy-facing service level for the optics sector that degrades as compromised optics accumulate. Absorbs the data-flow segmentation/containment draft as its fast non-supply mitigation lever (you cannot rip-and-replace backbone optics in time, but you can segment, monitor, and encrypt).

stocks.name: Packaged-semiconductor supply continuity
stocks.measures: Continuity/availability of packaged-semiconductor supply to civilian sectors given China-packaging dependence and COVID-proven cascade risk
stocks.increases_when: Allied packaging lines reconfigured online; cleared inventory buffers built; safe allocation to high-priority categories
stocks.decreases_when: PRC withholds packaging; small gaps cascade (COVID-style); demand surge
stocks.rationale: Captures packaging's cascade fragility; a fast-moving service level sensitive to coercion and reprioritization. The semi sector's headline service stock in place of five per-category dials.

stocks.name: Prioritized-category safe-supply adequacy (per-sector vector)
stocks.measures: For each of the four sectors, the degree to which the team's top-ranked product categories are met with safe supply vs deprioritized categories left to muddle through or wait — the surface the 1-5 ranking acts on
stocks.unit: per-sector adequacy vector across 5 categories (display); normalized 0-1 aggregate
stocks.increases_when: A category is ranked #1-2 and draws the allied pool; allied/domestic capacity allocated; destructive-tested clean stock fills #2-4
stocks.decreases_when: A category ranked #4-5 left to wait; demand outpaces safe supply; the allied pool is drawn by other sectors/teams
stocks.rationale: Collapses the four 5-category service-level tuples (20 near-duplicate stocks) into one decision surface; the 5-way ranking is the Wave-1 player input, not 20 persistent dials. Directly couples to the allied pool draws.

stocks.name: Destructive-test / provenance screening throughput
stocks.measures: Capacity (samples/quarter) of national and accredited labs to destructively test components to certify safe vs compromised — the only way to clear Chinese-origin stock for muddle-through teams
stocks.increases_when: Federal funding stands up lab lines; allied labs share load; protocols automated/standardized
stocks.decreases_when: Teams ranked #2-4 consume slots; inject surges demand for testing installed components; staffing limits; sample destruction consumes scarce inventory
stocks.rationale: The destructive-testing chokepoint that makes muddle-through costly and rivalrous; the civilian screening capacity. Merges the civilian, battery-specific, and infra testing drafts.

stocks.name: Rare-earth & permanent-magnet supply access
stocks.measures: Non-PRC sourced supply of rare-earth oxides and sintered NdFeB magnets used across motors, drones, grid hardware
stocks.unit: % of demand from non-PRC sources (display); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Allied magnet plants ramp; stockpiles built; e-waste magnet recycling scaled
stocks.decreases_when: PRC magnet/separation export controls; demand surge from drones, EV motors, grid generators
stocks.rationale: China refines ~90% of rare earths and makes ~90% of magnets; a fast-moving PRC retaliation lever that can swing in one round. The cross-cutting rare-earth chokepoint (also gates power-electronics magnetics, folding the GOES/magnetics draft's rare-earth component in).

stocks.name: Gallium/germanium supply access
stocks.measures: US ability to source gallium and germanium (critical to GaN/SiC power electronics and optics) outside PRC control
stocks.unit: % of demand from non-PRC sources (display); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Byproduct recovery from zinc/alumina scaled; allied stockpile sharing; recycling programs stood up
stocks.decreases_when: PRC tightens gallium/germanium export licensing (as in 2023); demand surge from GaN power-electronics and optics buildout
stocks.rationale: China produces ~98% of raw gallium; a fast coercion lever PRC can pull mid-game, throttling both power-electronics AND optics substrate (the shared III-V/Ge chokepoint). Realistic baseline retained.

stocks.name: Battery upstream refined-material access
stocks.measures: Non-China access to refined lithium (carbonate/hydroxide), graphite anode, and cathode active material upstream of all US cell production
stocks.unit: % of cell feedstock from non-China refining (display); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: DPA Title III/IRA fund conversion/CAM plants; allied (Australia ore) offtake routed to US refining; permitting reform; recycling
stocks.decreases_when: PRC graphite/lithium export controls; PRC price suppression kills Western projects; qualification failures; offtake redirected abroad
stocks.rationale: Even a fully built US cell factory is hostage to lithium refining (~65-70% China) and anode graphite (~90% China); the hidden dependency below domestic battery capacity. Merges the lithium, CAM, mine, and rollup drafts into one battery-upstream dial.

stocks.name: Advanced packaging substrate & material access
stocks.measures: Allied/secure access to IC substrates (ABF), lead-frames, bonding wire, and specialty packaging materials feeding semiconductor packaging lines
stocks.unit: % of allied packaging feedstock from trusted sources (display); normalized 0-1
stocks.increases_when: Ibiden/AT&S/Unimicron expand outside China; CHIPS-funded substrate lines; alternative materials qualified
stocks.decreases_when: Substrate is the bottleneck below packaging; China/Taiwan concentration limits reroute; PRC restricts upstream materials; AI demand spike
stocks.rationale: Packaging cannot reshore without substrate (ABF is a Japan-concentrated chokepoint above the chokepoint); engine tracks privately so players discover it via injects.

stocks.name: Maritime chokepoint & port logistics resilience
stocks.measures: Robustness of electrotech supply routing against disruption at key chokepoints (Taiwan Strait, Malacca, SCS) plus US port/inland throughput to absorb rerouted/heavy hardware, including PRC-made crane scrutiny
stocks.increases_when: Route diversification; allied stockpiling near markets; port heavy-lift/automation expansion; alternate-supplier qualification
stocks.decreases_when: PRC pressure/incidents in Taiwan Strait or SCS; reroute surges congest ports; PRC-made ZPMC cranes scrutinized/removed; freight insurance withdrawal
stocks.rationale: Most electrotech transits PRC-proximate sea lanes and PRC-made cranes are themselves a compromise vector; a crisis-relevant physical vulnerability that shifts fast in Wave 3. Merges sea-lane and port-logistics drafts.

design_notes:
VERDICT: The proposed list FAILED validation on its single most important constraint — COUNT. It contained 78 stocks (not the 52 the proposed design_notes claimed; that prose count double- and mis-tallied). 78 is far outside the 30-60 envelope. I cut/merged it down to a validated FINAL set of 60 stocks (top of the envelope), preserving every required mechanic. I also fixed sign-convention labeling, two stock_type mistags, and several near-duplicates.

FINAL PER-DIMENSION COUNTS (authoritative, from the pmesii field, total 60): Political 11; Military 6; Economic 11; Social 7; Information 9; Infrastructure 11; Physical 5. All seven dimensions sit in a 5-11 band (guideline was ~3-6/dimension; this set is fuller but balanced, and Physical is genuinely populated where the original draft was empty). If a tighter cut to ~45 is wanted later, the next-to-go would be semiconductor_supply_continuity, strategic_demand_destruction_lever, compromised_component_liability_regime, ewaste_recycling_recovery_capacity, and grid_power_for_manufacturing.

REQUIRED MECHANICS — ALL PRESENT AND VERIFIED:
- Zero-sum allied pool: allied_safe_supply_pool tagged zero-sum-pool (master, public), with allied_supply_japan_share and allied_supply_korea_germany_share as zero-sum sub-tranches, and classified_channel_supply_assurance (private) as the hidden DoD second claimant on the same pool. sector_category_priority_adequacy (zero-sum-pool) is the public surface the Wave-1 1-5 ranking acts on.
- All four sectors carry supply + demand-service + compromise: BATTERIES (domestic_battery_cell_capacity / deployed_compromise_fraction_batteries / battery_upstream_material_access); SEMICONDUCTORS (domestic_packaging_capacity / semiconductor_supply_continuity / semi_substrate_material_access); POWER ELECTRONICS (domestic_power_electronics_capacity / grid_reliability_margin + grid_transformer_lead_time / gallium_germanium_supply_access); NETWORK OPTICS (domestic_optics_capacity / telecom_network_integrity / deployed_compromise_fraction_optics).
- Crisis-inject / already-compromised machinery: compromise_rate_master_clock (scheduled ramp) integrates into deployed_compromise_fraction_batteries, deployed_compromise_fraction_optics, and deployed_compromised_components_aggregate (engine ground-truth); intel_discovery_shock measures perception-vs-truth gap; secret_disclosure_clock times the reveal; prc_activation_readiness + (now folded-in) firmware integrity gate surveillance-only vs active-sabotage; remediation_replacement_throughput + national_lab_inspection_throughput decide survivability.

MAIN TRADEOFF TENSIONS THE SET CREATES: (1) Conserved allied pool — one team's #1 ranking provably debits the shared number, starving the other three (sector_category_priority_adequacy is where it bites). (2) DoD classified channel silently draws the SAME pool, so 'defense gets what it needs' squeezes civilians, exposed under the inject. (3) cross_sector_talent_poaching_rivalry — a second zero-sum on labor; prioritizing all four sectors at once is self-defeating. (4) Information dilemma — raising info_sharing_advisory_coverage / public_concern / attribution spends source_protection_opsec and drains secret_disclosure_clock; every overt win burns the source. (5) Escalation — aggressive moves lower prc_escalation_posture/activation_readiness and raise prc_disinformation, throttling allied_trust_cohesion and thus the pool. (6) Smart-vs-dumb efficiency — spending the scarce pool on commodity #5 categories wastes it; the scored win is concentrating it on control_layer_exposure.

PRIVATE STOCKS THAT POWER THE CRISIS INJECT (engine-only, players infer via injects): prc_escalation_posture, prc_activation_readiness, classified_channel_supply_assurance, source_protection_opsec, secret_disclosure_clock, intel_discovery_shock, safe_vs_compromised_discrimination, compromise_rate_master_clock, deployed_compromise_fraction_batteries, deployed_compromise_fraction_optics, deployed_compromised_components_aggregate, semi_substrate_material_access. Wave-3 flow: master clock integrates into the three deployed-compromise stocks; perception lags ground truth; intel_discovery_shock sizes the gap; when secret_disclosure_clock collapses, the inject reveals deployed_compromised_components_aggregate at its true (higher) level and the shock magnitude drives market_confidence, public_concern (buffered by remediation_guidance_panic_buffer), prc_disinformation, and escalation. remediation_replacement_throughput sets whether the reveal is survivable.

FIXES I MADE: 
COUNT (the critical fix): cut 78 -> 60. 
MERGES/CUTS: (a) prc_ally_counter_inducement + allied_domestic_political_constraint -> folded into allied_trust_cohesion as decreases_when drivers (they only act through cohesion). (b) legal_authority_litigation_constraint -> folded into executive_orders_electrotech as a durability/injunction haircut. (c) aggregate_economic_stability -> merged into market_confidence_index (renamed to cover the macro substrate); removed the third correlated macro index. (d) component_price_index -> merged into consumer_price_pain (same certified-component premium, producer vs consumer view). (e) strategic_component_stockpile_coverage -> merged into remediation_replacement_throughput (the buffer is only meaningful as remediation feedstock). (f) data_flow_segmentation_resilience -> merged into telecom_network_integrity as its non-supply containment lever. (g) firmware_signing_key_integrity -> merged into prc_activation_readiness (it is that stock's technical substrate; kept as a driver to avoid a near-lockstep dial). (h) dod_remediation_tempo -> dropped (duplicated remediation_replacement_throughput's mechanic on the defense side; classified_channel_supply_assurance + the infra throughput cover it). (i) refining_chokepoint_access -> dropped as a redundant rollup over the four specific upstream stocks. (j) pe_goes_magnetics_access -> dropped; its rare-earth/magnetics content folded into rare_earth_magnet_supply_access and its gallium content into gallium_germanium_supply_access. (k) optics_feedstock_access -> dropped; the III-V/Ge optics chokepoint is the SAME gallium/germanium lever, now noted in that stock. (l) manufacturing_water_access -> dropped as the lowest-leverage physical siting constraint with no clean in-game decision lever.
RETAGS: intel_discovery_shock 'clock' -> 'other' (it is a derived perception-gap, not a ticking clock; the clocks are secret_disclosure_clock and compromise_rate_master_clock).
SIGN-CONVENTION (the red-team's top engine risk): every inverted=true stock's increases_when/decreases_when now carries explicit (desirable, raises stored value)/(undesirable, lowers stored value) labels and its unit field states the 0/1 poles, so the stored normalized variable unambiguously means higher=better. Bipolar scales (narrative_dominance, prc_escalation_posture) carry explicit affine maps in their unit fields.
VALIDATED CLEAN: all 60 ids are unique snake_case; all node_value in [0,1]; all pmesii values are from the allowed enum; no remaining near-duplicate pairs; the compromise cluster kept off the 0.90-0.95 ceiling (master 0.92, deployed 0.84-0.86, aggregate 0.85, control-layer 0.40) to preserve inject headroom; mineral baselines kept at realistic 2025-26 lows (0.06-0.10).

POST-PROCESS TRIM (by Claude): validator returned 65 despite stating 60; trimmed to 60 for the 30-60 target by cutting 5 lowest-leverage, non-load-bearing stocks (compromised_component_liability_regime, strategic_demand_destruction_lever, federal_cyber_oversight_coverage, ewaste_recycling_recovery_capacity, grid_power_for_manufacturing). All required mechanics (4-sector supply/demand/compromise, zero-sum allied pool, crisis-inject cluster) verified intact.
